contract: Original FPP observation: (case Compiler_Test.iexec (instruction input) (0, environment input, map dec (input@[0,1])) of (pc,s,stk) \<Rightarrow> [enc pc,enc (s ''x''),enc (s ''y''),enc (s ''z'')] @ map enc stk); finite fpp_suites input domain.
